home.bannerBody: New NWU papers land in the library regularly — search by subject, module, and grade.
home.liveAnchorUnavailable: The library is being refreshed — papers are added regularly. Check back soon.
home.heroSubtitle: ISCHOOL iku xhumanisa nabafundi abase module efanayo nawe, ekhempasini yakho, befunda okuqukethwe okufanayo — akukho mbuzo ohlala ubambekile. Amaphepha adlule, umeluleki we-AI, izivivinyo zansuku zonke, kanye nesibalo sohlelo lokufunda — konke eplathifomu eyakhiwe ngokucophelela okuyindleko enkulu ukuyisebenzisa.
home.proofDetail0: Okuqukethwe kwesikole okuhambisana ne-CAPS kanye nokwesekelwa kwe-NWU module okuqedukile ndawonye.
home.proofDetail1: Yakhelwe ngokucophelela kweziqu zomsebenzi futhi kunikezwa ngokuvuleka — ngoba ukufinyeleleka kwezemfundo ephezulu akufanele kuncike ebungakanani besikhwama sakho.
home.proofDetail2: Isebenza edatheni elinganiselwe. Akukho mavidiwo anzima, akukho okudluliswa okuphoqiwe.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Amakamelo e-module agcina imibuzo emise okuthile. Izimpendulo ezamukelwe zithola amakhredithi e-Scholar. Ukubhaliswa okungaziwa kusho ukuthi akekho onovalo lokubuza.
home.step01Body: Buza ekamelweni le-module yakho. Yiba nencazelo ethile noma ulokhu uzwa kuphela — omunye ekhempasini yakho unemibuzo efanayo.
home.step02Body: Abafundi abazibambe beqondi baphendula. Phendula ngombuzo ofanayo ukuze watshelwe uma iphatha.
home.step03Body: Marka impendulo esiziqeqeshelwe kakhulu njengoyamukelekile. Ophendulile uthola ama-20 Scholar Credits. Bonke bald zabhalela.
home.featureAskModuleDesc: Faka umbuzo ekamelweni le-module yakho bese uthola izimpendulo kozakwenu abazibambile. Marka impendulo njengemukelekayo futhi uthole ama-Credits e-Scholar.
home.featureAiTutorDesc: Akuyena umngwano othize. Buza mayelana ne-module yakho ekhethekile, nephethini lesikhungo sakho, noma umqondo wezikilasi zalesi simiso evikini. Iyazi isimo sakho.
home.featurePastPapersDesc: Amaphepha adlule asemthethweni ngephondo, ibanga, nesifundo. Akudingeki ukubhalisela kusekeni. Umtapo we-SA wephepha adlule ophelele kakhulu atholakala ku-intanethi.
home.featureDailyQuizDesc: Isinye isivivinyo njalonjalo ngosuku. Khomba izindawo zakho ezibuthakathaka futhi uthumele imibuzo eziphinda. Gcina isiqalo sakho siphila futhi ukhuphuke kwi-leaderboard.
home.featurePlannerDesc: Ukuhambisana ne-CAPS kwababafundi besikole. Based-uploadable kubafundi baseyunivesithe. Ishisini lakho ngesikhathi sakho, njengesakhiwo esakhiwe ngazinto ezimele.
home.featureGamesDesc: I-BRAZIL, indaba yosizo lwezingane ngokuzibuza imelanele enyakazini. I-Exam Dash — i-MCQ ishesha ngebhuku lezesifundo — isiqale. Imidlalo eminingi iba khona.
home.whySchoolSubtitle: Yakhelwe umfundi waseNingizimu Afrika — ayingusizo lomhlaba wonke emhlabeni jikelele.
home.trustCopy0: IBanga R kuze kufike kulolu lwazi. Okuqukethwe kwesikole okuhambisana ne-CAPS kanye nese-NWU ngesikimu esisodwa.
home.trustCopy1: Ukutholakala okuxhumekile. Idatha elula yezingxenye eziseningizimu Afrika. Akusebensi amakhadi wesikweletu, akukho vidiyos etanya, akukho ukulandwa eluthwa kuthiwa — izindleko zokuhlelwa kwesitfashisi kuyisiphathe, akusiye ngako.
home.trustCopy2: Umphakathi uthola isimo esishesha kakhulu ezingxakini ngokulandela umnyombo olinganayo.
home.trustCopy3: Ngokuvusa nokufudumele. Okukhulunywa kwenhlangano, oku enanxusayo. SCHOOL iyaziphatha.
home.liveAnchorLastAdded: Ibhuku lokugcina elifakwe {relativeDate}. Itholakala lolu hlolo ivuselelwe ukuzikhandla.
home.liveAnchorFeaturesBody: Ulwazi oluninzi lweplathifomu? Bona konke okukhonjiswe kwiphropuesta — nezinye ezizokwenzeka.
home.missionHeading: Yakhelwe wonke umuntu waseNingizimu Afrika. Izitshalo ezinamandla ekufundeni ezingenankani noma ubuhlanga.
home.missionPara1: Isikole saqondwa ngu-Moloti Ditshego hhayi isikole esiku-intanethi, kodwa isithoko ukohlanganise izinjongo, ulayini lwengi, iminekanye eqinisekisa umphetho osezingeni eliphezulu masana kazi abasezintshwe ezinhle zakuleli, ngaphandle kokungaphili ophina.
home.missionPara2: Umthelela nokwakhiwa kwalomtho kwaphakanyiswa ukuthenga nakwezinye izinto ezizabhalayo obominika kuze kube sekusebenzele. Akutholile lapha kwakhelwe ngomqondo ongaqinisayo obengazi kuncikiley kona kuphumelele ngokuba nomqondo ongaqinile — kephaphuce kanjalo.
home.missionPara3Post: — ngesikhathi esibhekayo esangesikhundleni sokuthi ufuna ukuthuthuka nezinye. Ukuthuthukisa khoqobo kuphela uma ulwazi selwenza amandla asikho. E-SCHOOL, siqonde kahle ukuthi lokhu kuzofunda konke kuqala — kuthi ani.
home.missionPara4: IDitshego Ventures izibongi kubo bonke abazigonile lokhu kwenza kwenzeke. Izibongozo zizokunika izinhlu elihle kakhulu esikhathini somphakathi, ekulezi sizathu qudwa.
home.socialSubtitle: Thola iziphithiphithi zokufunda, izindaba zekhempasi, nokufingqa komphakathi ekhasini lethu elisemthethweni.
